meta.name: social-media-finder-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users automatically find social media profiles across platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc. using the BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like finding someone's social media accounts, discovering a brand's social media presence, tracking down social profiles of job candidates, finding contact info for sales prospects, researching a person's digital footprint, verifying the identity of someone met online, monitoring the social media reach of influencers, checking social accounts of business competitors, gathering public profiles for background research, locating official customer service accounts across platforms, or compiling contact databases for networking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动查找多平台社交媒体账号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取个人或品牌的社交账号信息。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically find social media profiles across platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to gather social media accounts for leads or research.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的姓名或品牌名，自动搜索 Facebook、Twitter、Instagram、LinkedIn 等多个平台的社交账号，并返回包含个人主页链接、用户名、粉丝数和简介的 CSV 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要查找某人的社交媒体账号、了解品牌的社交存在、收集销售线索或进行背景调查时，Claude 会自动触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我找一下 John Smith 的社交媒体账号。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并返回 CSV 文件。

say.text: 查找 Tesla 在各大平台的官方账号。
say.note: Claude 会搜索品牌并返回结果。

say.text: 搜索 Bill Gates 的 LinkedIn 和 Twitter。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回相关平台信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically search for social media profiles of individuals or brands across platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc., and return a CSV file with profile URLs, usernames, follower counts, and bio snippets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find someone's social media accounts, discover a brand's presence, gather sales leads, or conduct background research.

say_en.text: Find social media accounts for John Smith.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return a CSV file.

say_en.text: Look up Tesla's official accounts on major platforms.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the brand and return results.

say_en.text: Search for Bill Gates on LinkedIn and Twitter.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the search and return relevant platform info.
